semantics.definition: A real checkbox Eidos draws, with its words: on is lime with a tick, locked looks locked.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one checkbox every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Answer a yes or no, with its words; clicking the words ticks it too.

form.list: in a list, with its words
form.tile: a tile with what it does, tinted while on
